generated_for: Michel Junod Surfboards official model catalog

brands.name: Michel Junod Surfboards
brands.short_description: Michel Junod surfboard shaper from Santa Cruz, known for single-fin logs, quad fishes, performance boards, and collabs with Thomas Campbell. Boards are shaped at Global Glassing in Oceanside, California.

models.name: Speed Seed
models.description: 5'8"–7'0". Super-fun wider single fin round pin for easy take offs and speedy rides. Beak nose and relaxed entry rocker with slight V and double barrel concave tail. Early into average to hollow 2'–8' surf. Comes with an 8" MJ Flex Fin.

models.name: Carver
models.description: 6'0"–8'6". For turning hard and going fast in head-high surf. Streamlined outline with enough volume to catch plenty of waves. 2+1 fin setup for drive off the bottom with easy-off-the-top thruster feel. Slight V and double barrel concave in the tail.

models.name: Easy Rider
models.description: 8'6"–10'6". Designed as the one longboard quiver for most conditions from 2' to 8'. Medium-weight longboard that catches waves easily, with more kick in the nose for bigger waves. Down rails in the tail with slight V and double barrel concave. Clean outline with enough nose area for noseriding when the conditions are right.

models.name: The Smooth Slider
models.description: 9'0"–10'6". All-around log with glide and maneuverability. Joint design by Thomas Campbell and Michel Junod. Slightly piggish outline with the wide point behind center. Nose is slightly narrower than a typical noserider but still stable for walking and noseriding. Comes with a 3/16" Bass / 3/16" Redwood T-band stringer and its own 9.5" Smooth Slider model fin.

models.name: Diamond Tail Single Fin
models.description: 6'0"–7'6". A modern twist on 70s single fins, not a retro single fin. Beak nose with slightly more chest volume for easy paddling, modern tail rocker, and double-barrel concave tail contours. Ridden by Michel Junod in Thomas Campbell's movie The Present. Comes with an 8" MJ Flex Fin.

models.name: Big Five Diamond
models.description: 6'0"–8'0". Extra full-volume shortboard to increase wave count while still surfing aggressively. Aimed at XL and XXL surfers who need a shortboard that floats and catches waves. Five Future boxes to ride as a quad or thruster. Comes with Future fiberglass thruster or quad fins.

models.name: Junod Egg
models.description: 6'6"–8'0". Mid-range single-fin for glide and easy turning in small to head-high surf. Not a hull with soft rails: fast modern bottom with double-barrel concave and hard rails in the tail. Relaxed rocker for paddling and easy takeoffs. Comes with a 7.5" or 8" MJ Flex Fin depending on size.

models.name: Performance Pintail
models.description: 8'6"–9'6". Fastest longboard model in the catalog. Comes alive in 4'–10' waves. More rocker than the other longboards for steep drops and fast, hollow waves. Available as a single fin or 2+1.

models.name: The R.O.N.
models.description: 9'0"–10'6". Regular Old Noserider. All-around log with an emphasis on walking to the nose. Blended nose concave for lift and control. Shaped from US Blanks Classic density foam for a solid 60s-log feel. Fin box 4" from the tail for noseriding. 60/40 rails. Comes with the 9.75" MJ Pivot Fin from Rainbow Fins.
